description: Source file implementing logging central functions for buffering and output management in an EFI-based firmware environment.

methods.name: scheduleLogging
methods.description: Appends thread-local logging buffer to the global accumulation buffer, with buffer size checks.

methods.name: swapOutputBuffers
methods.description: Swaps the output and accumulation buffers, returning the current output buffer for transmission.

methods.name: printPending
methods.description: Sends all pending buffered logs to the output layer.

methods.name: scheduleMsg
methods.description: Formats and schedules a log message for buffering, with thread safety.
